items.title: Host repos can commit Docs/story evidence without stale-looping DONE
items.context: When a host project such as Cord Team Mac stores Koala story evidence under uppercase Docs/story/..., committing checklist/test-evidence/process-events after a green validation must remain metadata-only: DONE pre-check should report evidence fresh instead of forcing another stale-evidence cycle.
items.userSees: DONE pre-check prints "[PASS] Evidence freshness" after committing Docs/story/actives/.../test-evidence.json instead of "EVIDENCE STALE" naming Docs/story paths.

happy.desc: Changing uppercase Docs/story/actives/B-smoke/checklist.json after recording evidence remains metadata-only and checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit stays fresh.

edge.desc: Dirty worktree classification categorizes uppercase Docs/story/actives/... files as koala_metadata_changes, not unexpected_dirty_files.

adversarial.desc: Non-story docs such as docs/requirements/decisions/ADR-001.md and source files still count as material and stale old evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Freshness smoke now includes uppercase Docs/story/actives/B-smoke/checklist.json, process-events.jsonl, and test-evidence.json in metadataOnly and proves head-diff freshness, materialHash freshness, and coverage remain fresh.
Dirty worktree classifier smoke includes Docs/story/actives/B-smoke/test-evidence.json and expects koala_metadata_changes count 2, proving uppercase story evidence is not unexpected_dirty_files.
Existing material path assertions still require packages/main source, fixtures, package files, koala.config.json, and docs/requirements files to stale evidence.

items.title: Material source changes still stale evidence while Docs/story metadata is exempt
items.context: The regression must prove both sides of the safety boundary: uppercase Docs/story metadata remains excluded from material freshness, and real source/package/config files still change materialHash and make old evidence stale.
items.userSees: Smoke output reaches "Verification intent coverage: covered" for Docs/story metadata, while assertions still report real material paths as stale.

happy.desc: verification-freshness smoke covers uppercase Docs/story metadata for isMaterialExcludedPath, head-diff freshness, materialHash freshness, and coverage status.

edge.desc: field regression validate CLI surface passes for metadata-only story evidence commits so a committed evidence update remains covered instead of stale.

adversarial.desc: The same smoke keeps real material paths stale, proving the Docs/story exemption does not allow weak evidence to pass after source/package/config changes.

verificationEvidence.note: The smoke covers isMaterialExcludedPath plus freshAfterChanging, materialFreshAfterChanging, and coverageStatusWithMaterialHash for uppercase Docs/story metadata.
Field regression CLI smoke passes after preserving metadata-only evidence validation surface and updating brittle CLI message assertions to current schema output.
The same smoke keeps real material paths stale, so the Docs/story exemption does not allow stale evidence after real source/package/config/requirements changes.
